title.narrative: GER3 Response to Critical Humanitarian Shelter Needs In Kherson Oblast

description.narrative: ltpgtProject Summaryltbrgt 500 households provided with light and medium repairs ltbrgt 1500 vulnerable beneficiaries directly targetedlt/pgtltpgtltbrgtGER3 seeks to provide targeted, coordinated, and critical single-sectoral humanitarian assistance to vulnerable internally displaced persons (IDPs), returnees, and other conflict-affected people in the de-occupied areas of Kherson oblast through the provision of light and medium repairs to damaged households. Specifically, the program will address the compounded needs of 1500 people - specifically targeting people with disabilities, older persons, women and children and other vulnerable categories - in Beryslavski Raion in direct response to needs as identified by GER3 and its partners through needs assessments, secondary data analysis, and coordination with local governments, the local communities involved, the SNFI Cluster, and other humanitarian entities. The Beryslavski Raion is marked by an intersectoral needs severity of catastrophic, according to the 2023 MSNA. The proposed assistance will address a critical gap in the humanitarian response in the region, where shelter has been identified as one of the most critical humanitarian needs. ltbrgtltbrgtlt/pgtltpgtGER3 and its partner are present and have existing relationships with local governments and civil society partners in the area of implementation, as well as an ongoing winterization-focused program funded by the UHF. This presence has provided GER3 with a high level of contextual knowledge and understanding of humanitarian needs, as well as an appreciation of the challenges and mitigating actions required to operate safely and effectively in the region.nbsp ltbrgtlt/pgtltpgtSpecifically,nbspGER3 will provide light repairs to 200 households and medium repairs to 100 households, while its sub-implementing partner District 1 will provide light repairs to 150 householdsnbspand medium repairs to 50 households. GER3 and its partner both will work in Beryslavskyi rayon of Kherson oblast, Velykooleksandivska hromada, but will cover different villages.nbsp lt/pgt
